title: USE LOTS OF MEMORY TO RESAMPLE DCONN
description:
This command does the same thing as running -cifti-resample twice, but uses memory up to approximately 2x the size that the intermediate file would be.  This is because the intermediate dconn is kept in memory, rather than written to disk, and the components before and after resampling/dilation have to be in memory at the same time during the relevant computation.  The <template-direction> argument should usually be COLUMN, as dtseries, dscalar, and dlabel all have brainordinates on that direction.  If spheres are not specified for a surface structure which exists in the cifti files, its data is copied without resampling or dilation.  Dilation is done with the 'nearest' method, and is done on <new-sphere> for surface data.  Volume components are padded before dilation so that dilation doesn't run into the edge of the component bounding box.

To get the v1.3.2 and earlier behavior of weighted dilation, specify exponent of 2 for surface and volume, and -legacy-cutoff for both surface and volume.

The <volume-method> argument must be one of the following:

CUBIC
ENCLOSING_VOXEL
TRILINEAR

The <surface-method> argument must be one of the following:

ADAP_BARY_AREA
BARYCENTRIC

cifti_template.description: a cifti file containing the cifti space to resample to

template_direction.description: the direction of the template to use as the resampling space, ROW or COLUMN

surface_largest.description: use largest weight instead of weighted average when doing surface resampling

legacy_cutoff.description: use v1.3.2 logic for the kernel cutoff

volume_predilate.description: dilate the volume components before resampling

legacy_cutoff.description: use v1.3.2 logic for the kernel cutoff

surface_postdilate.description: dilate the surface components after resampling

source_volume.description: the source volume used when generating the affine

target_volume.description: the target volume used when generating the affine

flirt.description: MUST be used if affine is a flirt affine

affine.description: use an affine transformation on the volume components

fnirt.description: MUST be used if using a fnirt warpfield

warpfield.description: use a warpfield on the volume components

current_sphere.description: a sphere with the same mesh as the current left surface

new_sphere.description: a sphere with the new left mesh that is in register with the current sphere

current_area.description: a relevant left anatomical surface with current mesh

new_area.description: a relevant left anatomical surface with new mesh

left_area_surfs.description: specify left surfaces to do vertex area correction based on

current_area.description: a metric file with vertex areas for the current mesh

new_area.description: a metric file with vertex areas for the new mesh

left_area_metrics.description: specify left vertex area metrics to do area correction based on

left_spheres.description: specify spheres for left surface resampling

current_sphere.description: a sphere with the same mesh as the current right surface

new_sphere.description: a sphere with the new right mesh that is in register with the current sphere

current_area.description: a relevant right anatomical surface with current mesh

new_area.description: a relevant right anatomical surface with new mesh

right_area_surfs.description: specify right surfaces to do vertex area correction based on

current_area.description: a metric file with vertex areas for the current mesh

new_area.description: a metric file with vertex areas for the new mesh

right_area_metrics.description: specify right vertex area metrics to do area correction based on

right_spheres.description: specify spheres for right surface resampling

current_sphere.description: a sphere with the same mesh as the current cerebellum surface

new_sphere.description: a sphere with the new cerebellum mesh that is in register with the current sphere

current_area.description: a relevant cerebellum anatomical surface with current mesh

new_area.description: a relevant cerebellum anatomical surface with new mesh

cerebellum_area_surfs.description: specify cerebellum surfaces to do vertex area correction based on

current_area.description: a metric file with vertex areas for the current mesh

new_area.description: a metric file with vertex areas for the new mesh

cerebellum_area_metrics.description: specify cerebellum vertex area metrics to do area correction based on

cerebellum_spheres.description: specify spheres for cerebellum surface resampling
